rulings.EC-CER-14: After 5 consecutive goal-met days S078 + S080 collapse into a row on S067 ONLY when the bundle is gems-only; any freeze, boost or tier grant keeps its full screen. Implemented in bundle.ts:collapseGoalChain, falsified in __falsifiers__/EC-CER-14.json.
rulings.EC-CER-22 vs the INV-CER-14 registry lin: CONFLICT, resolved in favour of EC-CER-22. The registry summarises INV-CER-14 as `renders the picker at most once per streak run`; EC-CER-22 (dated, cited R3L1-02 and R4L1-02) says `re-show S5 at most once more, then write a DECLINED sentinel` AND `re-render S5 once on the first session of the new run`. Those cannot both hold: the day-1 defer and its single re-show happen inside one streak run (on day 1 there is no streak at all), so the opening ladder is two presentations in one run. EC-CER-22 wins because it is the grounded ruling and the registry line is its summary. What ships, in streakGoal.ts: (1) at most MAX_UNPICKED_PRESENTATIONS = 2 CONSECUTIVE un-picked presentations ever, the second writing the permanent DECLINED sentinel; (2) a pick resets that counter; (3) a break after a pick re-arms the picker for exactly RENDERS_GRANTED_AFTER_A_BREAK = 1 render in the new run, while a break part-way through the opening ladder grants nothing. Properties in streakGoal.test.ts assert clauses (1) and (3) by name.

falsifiers: packages/core/src/ceremony/__falsifiers__/*.json, consumed by the tests whose names contain `falsifier` (pnpm test:falsify).
